facts.text: Ka'ana is a boutique hotel in San Ignacio, in Belize's Cayo District, set on the edge of the wilderness.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on the edge of the lush wilderness in San Ignacio, Cayo, Ka’ana Boutique Hotel

facts.text: The resort sits at the doorstep of Xunantunich, the ancient Maya temple.
facts.excerpt: Our retreat in San Ignacio, Belize, sits at the doorstep of Xunantunich, the ancient Maya temple.

facts.text: The name Ka'ana means 'heavenly place' in the ancient Maya language.
facts.excerpt: Our name, Ka’ana, means “heavenly place” in the ancient Maya language

facts.text: The resort has an organic on-site garden.
Ool Spa uses local botanicals and Mayan healing techniques in an intimate spa surrounded by tropical gardens.
facts.excerpt: Step inside our intimate spa surrounded by tropical gardens, where deeply restorative treatments channel the power of local botanicals and time-honored Mayan healing techniques

facts.text: The spa is best known for its Maya Abdominal Massage, a traditional healing technique.
facts.excerpt: The spa is best known for its Maya Abdominal Massage, a traditional healing technique

facts.text: Spa scrubs and wraps use regional ingredients like cacao, coffee, sugar and local herbs.
facts.excerpt: They also incorporate regional ingredients like cacao, coffee, sugar, and local herbs into their scrubs and wraps

facts.text: Spa treatments can be taken in indoor treatment rooms or in outdoor settings across the property, including under the jungle canopy.
facts.excerpt: While there are serene indoor treatment rooms, guests can also opt for a massage in various outdoor settings across the property. Many travelers choose to have their sessions under the jungle canopy

facts.text: Sunrise yoga classes are held on a dedicated jungle platform or at nearby Mayan temples.
facts.excerpt: Sunrise Yoga: Classes are held on a dedicated jungle platform or even at nearby Mayan temples.

facts.text: In the Maya Cooking Class guests cook classic dishes like tamales, corn tortillas and caldo on a fogon, an authentic Maya stove.
facts.excerpt: In this class, you’ll create classic dishes like tamales, corn tortillas, and caldo using the fogon, an authentic Maya stove, in our remake of a traditional kitchen.

facts.text: Each evening there is a fireside campfire with roasted marshmallows.
facts.excerpt: Each evening, join us fireside for a cozy campfire experience. With crackling flames, roasted marshmallows

facts.text: Tours and excursions are arranged by the resort's Guest Experience Team.
facts.excerpt: Step beyond the resort and into a world of exploration - all seamlessly arranged by our dedicated Guest Experience Team.

facts.text: The resort offers guided horseback rides, including a ride to Xunantunich after crossing the Mopan River on a hand-cranked ferry.
facts.excerpt: After crossing the Mopan River on the hand-cranked ferry, you will horseback ride along the trail leading to Xunantunich

facts.text: Spa slots fill up quickly in peak season (November to May), so booking 24 to 48 hours ahead is highly recommended.
facts.excerpt: It is highly recommended to book at least 24 to 48 hours in advance, especially during the peak season (November–May), as the boutique nature of the resort means slots fill up quickly

facts.text: Excursions include the ATM cave in the Tapir Mountain Nature Reserve, reached by a 45-minute trek that includes wading across 3 rivers.
facts.excerpt: Your adventure begins with a 45-minute trek that includes wading across 3 rivers
